plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for investing: copy a famous investor's 13F, watch the news, size trades to your budget, track Congress's stock disclosures, read earnings, screen, check risk, draft approved orders with Interactive Brokers or Questrade, Canadian ACB, capital gains and superficial losses, price alerts and rebalancing.
